canonical_equations: T=(JD_TT-2451545)/36525;IERS(5.40) Fukushima–Williams polynomials;R=X(-epsilon)*Z(-psi)*X(phi)*Z(gamma), evaluated as stable conjugation M*X(phi-epsilon)*Z(gamma);output R*v;ordered RN32.
input_contract: N1..4096;binary32-hex tt_centuries in[-1,1],vectors[N,3];explicit TT/GCRS/MEAN_EQUATOR_EQUINOX_OF_DATE_IAU2006 tags;finite executed intermediates.
output_contract: N x16 binary32[gamma,phi-epsilon,psi,epsilon,R row-major9,transformed_xyz];mean-of-date only,no nutation/apparent-place corrections or microarcsecond accuracy guarantee.
result_contract: N x16 binary32[gamma,phi-epsilon,psi,epsilon,R row-major9,transformed_xyz];mean-of-date only,no nutation/apparent-place corrections or microarcsecond accuracy guarantee.
precision_requirements: Finite IEEE binary32 values, explicitly supplied as eight hex digits (encoding=binary32-hex). Every +,-,*,/,sqrt rounds to nearest ties-to-even; gradual underflow; canonical positive zero after arithmetic. No FMA or reassociation. Nonfinite inputs, intermediate overflow, division by zero and invalid roots reject the job on CPU before dispatch. Bit identity is to this specified rounded algorithm, not exact real arithmetic or other library reduction orders.
validation_method: Full byte comparison against independent exact-rational RN32 CPU oracle; analytic, adversarial and held-out vectors; arithmetic tested separately.
